name: Call of Duty: Deluxe Edition
storyline: Call of Duty follows three intertwined campaigns set during the Second World War. In the American campaign, Private Martin of the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment moves from basic training at Camp Toccoa into the chaos of the Normandy airdrops on D-Day, fighting alongside whatever soldiers he can find. The British campaign follows Sergeant Jack Evans, who takes part in the glider assault on Pegasus Bridge before transferring to the SAS for sabotage missions deep behind enemy lines. The Soviet campaign traces Corporal Voronin from the desperate river crossing at Stalingrad, where retreat means execution, onward through the brutal fighting on the Eastern Front. Across all three perspectives, ordinary soldiers are swept into some of the war's most pivotal battles.
summary:
The New Leader in World War II action - Now available in this Deluxe Edition Box Set.

Experience the cinematic intensity of World War II's epic battles, fighting on foot, in tanks, jeeps, motorcycles and even a bomber. Work with your squad through snow and rain, using authentic weapons including flamethrowers and deployable machine guns, or by calling in artillery strikes.

Plan your attack with the Call of Duty and United Offensive Official Strategy Guides. Relive the music with the Call of Duty official soundtrack.
